# Zuri LMS — Community Edition

> Self-hosted tyre inspection and fleet logistics for small fleets.
> Open source, MIT licensed, no telemetry. This site is the marketing page —
> the application source, docs and schema live on GitHub.

## Links

- Source code: https://github.com/esoken92/zuri-lms
- Quickstart: https://github.com/esoken92/zuri-lms#quickstart
- Release roadmap (shipped / deferred / out of scope):
  https://github.com/esoken92/zuri-lms/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md
- Environment setup: https://github.com/esoken92/zuri-lms/blob/main/.env.example
- Database migrations: https://github.com/esoken92/zuri-lms/tree/main/supabase/migrations

## What it is

Next.js 16 + React 19 + Supabase (Postgres, Auth, RLS). Features:
tyre inspections, scrap/write-off tracking, reports & analytics, BLE tyre
sensor reads, role-based access (admin/manager/inspector), approval
workflow, offline inspection drafts.

To run it, a cloner supplies their own Supabase project and sets
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY /
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (server-only). Demo accounts via
`NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE` + `scripts/create-demo-users.mjs`.
